correctness.rationale: A balanced interior edge from the subcubic weak dual is combined with Rivera Laboy's bounded-boundary separator lemma. Recursive attachment of child tree-cut decompositions adds at most the component edge boundary to any old adhesion, and the resulting recurrence closes with the explicit constant 40.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. arXiv:2609.03755v2 explicitly poses the outerplanar O(sqrt n) screewidth question, and targeted exact/equivalent searches found no prior resolution; residual risk from extremely recent or not-yet-indexed parallel work is documented in REVIEW.md.

value.rationale: The theorem answers an explicit current open question and, together with the fan lower bound, determines the extremal order of screewidth on outerplanar graphs as Theta(sqrt n).

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
